name: Spunto IDE
description: An in-browser VS Code (code-server) wearing the Spunto brand, and nothing else — for a platform that installs the IDE apart from the terminal plumbing of spunto-pack (installCodeServer: false). Same install script as spunto-pack.

codeServerVersion.description: code-server version to install, e.g. 4.101.2. 'latest' resolves at build time.

brand.description: Rebrand code-server as Spunto: the name in product.json, the favicon and PWA icons, and two built-in themes (Spunto Light, Spunto Dark). 'none' keeps code-server as shipped.

strict.description: Fail the build when code-server cannot be installed. Off by default: the build ends with a warning instead.
